body: Head 08e6fa3b05, 0 behind main. Gate: check-ci-fast 32/32, test-touched 335 passed, check-ci-compile after each main merge. BUG-2179 ACs: (1) one log walk + one cat-file for all traced specs (and one -G walk for deleted ones); a test counts 3 gits / 2 walks for 40 specs; (2) results equal the per-spec walk on a fixture (test), and the alias map equals the per-id search (test); (3) step 1 median 291s -> 48s on PR #2773's 108 specs (loads in PR/spec). <30s warm is NOT met: the walk is CPU-bound over 67k store commits. Refusals stay as strict: --all is kept, and a test proves an excluded earlier version found through the batch is still refused. Plus a bounded 3x re-collect when the store changes mid-scan (your BUG-2179 comment). BUG-2184: scan time is excluded from the --wait deadline, and the CI wait polls at least once (tests for green/pending/red with a zero budget). Note: my first push of this branch went out 4 commits behind main by mistake; I merged main, re-gated, and pushed 0 behind. Next: item 3 (BUG-2174 option (a) only), in a fresh session; this one is over its context ceiling.
